prompt: a photorealistic face-on photograph of a BICYCLE WHEEL -- hub in the centre, a round rim, and straight metal SPOKES running from the hub out to the rim. There are 8 spokes. Paint every spoke a crisp bright BLUE so its line is clear. GEOMETRY IS THE SUBJECT and must be EXACT (do NOT default to some spokes pointing straight out and others slanted): this is a LACED (tangential) wheel, so EVERY spoke leaves the hub at the SAME lacing angle -- each spoke makes the identical angle to the straight-out radial direction, all spokes tilted by one common amount in the same rotational sense. The whole set of spokes shares ONE tangential lacing angle. Photoreal wheel, 8 blue spokes, hub and rim, no text, no numbers.
easy_question: This image was supposed to show a wheel with a hub, a rim and several blue spokes running from the hub to the rim. Ignoring quality, does it depict a wheel with a hub and several blue spokes? A photo or render both count. Answer NO only for a blank panel or no wheel/spokes. Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: one straight blue spoke running from the hub of the wheel out to the rim
